Smart homes were supposed to be the future.

Hollywood promised us houses that just worked.
Instead, we got disconnected apps, broken automations, voice assistants that fail basic commands, and a graveyard of abandoned smart home gadgets collecting dust in drawers.
So what happened?
In this episode, Caya dives into the hidden history of smart homes — from 1970s protocols like X10 to Zigbee, Z-Wave, Thread, Matter, Alexa, HomeKit, and the modern chaos of incompatible ecosystems.
We break down why smart homes feel so unreliable, why even simple automations fail constantly, why companies keep abandoning devices, and why the “Hollywood smart home” turned into a maintenance nightmare for normal people.
